verdict.rationale: Sentry documents the core of this story as first-party features. It has an 'Associate Commits' capability under Releases and a 'Suspect Commits' feature on issues. Code mappings are documented as enabling suspect commits, and sentry-cli can create and manage releases. However, most of this evidence is page titles or one-line mentions rather than in-depth descriptions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that each issue displays the release it first appeared in, detailed docs on how suspect commits are computed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
